_help.handSize: How many seeds each player holds; hands refill up to this. More = more choice each turn. Takes effect from the next new game (Save, then refresh).
_help.minWordLength: 2 = normal; 3 = the "2-letter words off" table option. Higher = harder to score. Takes effect from the next new game (Save, then refresh).
_help.ownershipBonus: Each of YOUR seeds in a word you make adds this much extra Magic (a word = its seeds + this per seed you own). Higher = using your own seeds matters more. Takes effect from the next new game (Save, then refresh).
_help.tangleBonus: At the end, for each tangled glyphling, every OTHER player gets this much Magic per seed or glyphling of theirs next to it. Higher = tangling rivals pays more. Takes effect from the next new game (Save, then refresh).
_help.tanglesToEnd: The game ends when a turn finishes with this many glyphlings tangled (or more). Higher = longer games. Takes effect from the next new game (Save, then refresh).

_labels.ownershipBonus: Bonus Magic per own seed in a word
_labels.tangleBonus: Tangle bonus Magic at the end (per neighbouring piece)
_labels.tanglesToEnd: Tangled glyphlings that end the game
